column3: Kirino Route · There's No Choice But To Use My Final Resort On My Little Sister
W-What are you trying to show me?! H-Hurry up and put it away!
T-This brat, she actually said something that would create a serious misunderstanding if it were to be heard by our parents.
It's not really something that you have to reject to that extent, right? Now then, let's hurry up and play "SisXSis".
I-I already told you not to show me that! You pervert!!
Who's the pervert? This is something you liked a lot in the past.
There's no way that's possible! Are you crazy?
Ah, geez! This development is the same as what happened at the beginning...
...Sorry, Kirino. You don't have the right to say no.
Why are you so confident this time?!
It's like what that grade schooler with brains of an adult says. There is only one truth.
No matter how much you deny it, the past can't be changed. You loved "SisXSis" so much that it's as though you were worshiping a god!
Lies! Lies, lies, lies! You're just trying to deceive me and turn me into a pervert just like you, aren't you?!
I'm not lying! It's all true! Look me in my eyes!
Don't point those eyes of a dead fish at me.
I-I told you to stop it...
Don't stare at me meaningfully like that.
I won't stare if you say you will play the game.
Guhh... But, it's still too...
No, I sympathize with you... but it's all the truth.
I hate the idea of that. I won't admit to it.
You said you won't admit to it... Really, I wish I could record that line you said just now and play it back to the 'you' from a year ago.
Guh... I wish I could give the past me a knockdown punch...
Listen here, this "SisXSis" was the only present you gave me.
However, I haven't completed it and I'm frequently being scolded by you to hurry up and finish it.
...You're the one who told me to play it. That's why, I'm telling you to do the same now.
Clear "Rinko's route" together with me.
I. Don't. Want. To!
You're the one who told me "to treasure it as if it were me", you know?!
No! That person might be me, but it certainly isn't me!
Don't say such selfish things! Didn't you once say you are yourself?!
Ahh, it's too complicated!
Gah, she cut my sure-kill sentence in two just like that...!
H-Hey, this is my final resort here. There is no other alternative.
Huh? Your final resort? You better work harder and come up with some other way.
In any case, I don't want to do this!!
In any case, I will not play it. No means no.
Don't say such childish things! That won't do!
I understand that... however...
Look at me, Kirino.
Have I ever lied to you since you've lost your memories? I have never lied to you, I'm sure you do know by now, right?!
...I am definitely your ally.
Guh...
... Kirino, are you serious?
Even like this, I believe I did my best for your sake.
If you reject this, there's nothing more I can do.
T-Those words... aren't fair...
I don't care anymore... I'm honestly tired of this...
Even if my memories won't return, as long as I act appropriately, it shouldn't bother you and those otaku friends, right?
That kind of act... probably won't work forever, right? Sooner or later, won't you surely be exposed?
If that happens, not only will you be hurt, but so will they.
Why must you say such things...
